g.text: AFTER — five concerns, five decorators, every order available
+RateLimitingPriceFeed(inner : PriceFeed, clock : Clock, limit : int, window : Duration)
is why its position in the chain
anyway: a decorator needs only the
requires one, and each concrete decorator passes it up. That
parameter *is* the wrapping: it is where a chain is joined, and
it is why any decorator can hold any other.
Six classes, all five concerns, every order.
A sixth concern is one new class and no edits —
the open-closed principle stated as an invoice.
Each decorator is testable alone, because it is
possible to have exactly one of them.
